summary: P-9 verified fixed: production MetaCredentialReader injects probeKeychain() (kSecReturnAttributes only, prompt-suppressed), detection() returns from the probe switch so keychainRead() is unreachable in production, and blocked is reserved for isACLBlockedStatus (-25308/-25293) with other failures reading .unavailable; the new test pins probe precedence. P-1..P-8 remain fixed; no new spec deviation.

findings.title: Card token footer never renders: scanner leaves modelBreakdown empty
findings.description: MuseSessionScanner returns CostEstimate without modelBreakdownToday/Last7 entries, so hasDisplayData is always false and CostFooterView renders nothing; the SDD card row for local tokens never appears.
findings.rule: spec §11 (Cartão: reutiliza VendorSectionView (plano, janelas com reset, rodapé de custo do scanner))

findings.title: Missing/blocked login throws a noisy credentials error instead of the empty/degraded state
findings.description: MetaProvider throws AppError.credentials for .missing/.keychainBlocked; cold-cache card goes .failed with red English text, the blocked message never matches isKeychainACLBlocked, and the §12 localized keychain-unavailable key does not exist.
findings.rule: spec §8 (sem credencial = estado vazio (§7.3), não erro)

findings.title: Muse session scanner runs even when Meta is disabled
findings.description: CostEstimator always invokes MuseSessionScanner and AiTaskbarApp always constructs/refreshes it, irrespective of config.meta.enabled.
findings.rule: spec §4.3 (Desligado: sem cartão, sem leituras de Keychain/auth.json, sem scan.)

findings.title: Settings detection shows only login boolean; sessions-presence and keychain-blocked states missing
findings.description: vendorMeta shows Detected/Not found only; an ACL-blocked item reads Detected, sessions presence is never shown, and the §12 'sem sessões do Muse encontradas' key is absent.
findings.rule: spec §11 (texto de estado detetado (login presente/ausente; sessões presentes/ausentes; Keychain bloqueado))

findings.title: Mint request follows redirects via HTTPClient.send
findings.description: MetaProvider uses fetchPayload, which routes to HTTPClient.send with URLSession default redirect handling, instead of refusing 3xx.
findings.rule: spec §8 (Host fixo, HTTPS, sem redirects (resposta 3xx = indisponível))

findings.title: vendorColorIndices has no .meta entry
findings.description: AnalyticsAggregator.vendorColorIndices still lists eight vendors without .meta, leaving a colliding fallback index.
findings.rule: spec §10 (Cor da marca: entrada .meta em vendorColorIndices)

findings.title: Mandated tests partial: only 401 covered; non-finite golden, validate scanner, rotating-skip absent
findings.description: No 403/429/5xx/stale provider tests, no non-finite used_percent golden, validate section lacks a scanner assert, and no test confirms the rotating label skips a utilization-less Meta snapshot.

findings.title: Scope creep: keychain payload accepts non-JSON and guessed token keys
findings.description: token(fromKeychainPayload:) accepts a bare string plus accessToken/token keys beyond the contracted JSON access-token payload.
findings.rule: spec §7.1 (o payload é JSON — extrair só o access token e validar o prefixo dca:)

findings.title: Settings detection reads the Keychain secret instead of attribute-only presence
findings.description: Fixed in 7625ca4: detection() (line 161) switches on keychainProbe with every case returning (keychainRead unreachable in production); probeKeychain() (line 273) sets kSecReturnAttributes only inside withPromptsSuppressed + UIFail; blocked is isACLBlockedStatus-only (-25308/-25293), other failures read .unavailable. Settings uses init(config:) (SettingsView.swift:805), which injects the probe (line 108).
findings.rule: spec §7.2 (Detetar "login existe?" (para Ajustes, §4.3) nunca pede o segredo: basta auth.json parseável nos termos acima ou presença do item por atributos.)

rounds.summary: P-1..P-8 verified fixed in current bodies; 1 new medium finding (P-9): Settings detection() reads the Keychain secret instead of attribute-only presence.
P-9 verified fixed in current bodies (attribute-only probe wired in production, ACL-only blocked, probe-precedence test); no new findings.
